coupling: The lossless sliding-window commit changes VP8LGetWindowRows() to return history rows after subtracting the fixed 16-row cache, while its own GetWindowRows() caller explicitly adds NUM_ARGB_CACHE_ROWS, copy headroom, and shift margin back. That commit is therefore safe on its own. The later alpha sliding-window commit introduces the public-to-internal alpha row-window consumer and calls the same helper with a 25-row history bound, but does not add the cache rows that the new helper contract excludes. The two commits together allocate only 9 alpha rows instead of the 25 retained rows required by the alpha decode path, and the public encode/decode probe reaches a heap out-of-bounds write in VP8LColorIndexInverseTransformAlpha. A correct repair must reconcile the shared helper's row semantics with the alpha caller introduced by the later commit; neither individual maintenance diff exposes the fault in isolation.
